offering_description.value: Operates a chain of ShopRite supermarkets under license, selling groceries, fresh foods, pharmacy items and general merchandise to household shoppers. Stores are company-operated and supplied largely through the Wakefern cooperative and its own warehouse.

primary_products.value: groceries; fresh produce, meat and seafood; bakery and deli foods; dairy and frozen foods; health and beauty and general merchandise

primary_services.value: in-store pharmacy; online grocery ordering with pickup and delivery; catering and prepared foods

customer_segment.value: B2C: household grocery shoppers in the New Jersey, New York and Pennsylvania area

revenue_model.value: product sales: groceries and general merchandise sold in stores and online; service fees: pharmacy dispensing and delivery fees

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys goods mainly from Wakefern cooperative and suppliers, sells to consumers through its supermarkets

geography_served.value: US regional: New Jersey, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Delaware and New York area, mainly the New Jersey metro region

specialization.value: niche specialist: one line: ShopRite-branded supermarkets with pharmacies

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated ShopRite supermarkets; online: ShopRite from Home online ordering with pickup and delivery

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety rules (FDA, USDA, state health), pharmacy licensing, and alcohol sales licensing in some stores

notes: Exact state footprint and any recent ownership change are uncertain.
